title: Lighter wind, kinder Gale
notes: The wind bed is at less than half again. The Updraft draws a miss nearly half-way home, the carry is lower on the first three skies, and the Gale's Dark climbs at three-quarters speed.
The wind's ribbons are pre-rendered now, so a phone paints them without dropping frames.
If a sky's start ever holds again: Options, Tester tools, screenshot the trace, send it — it now records stalls, ignored taps, music decode times and video errors.
